summary.text: Nick Danger is a nonpartisan candidate for the Alaska State Senate, District G, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Elvi Gray-Jackson, a Democrat.
He has run for Anchorage Assembly seats in 2020, 2023, 2025 and 2026.

paragraphs.text: Nick Danger ran for Anchorage Assembly District 3 Seat E in 2020, receiving 29.4 percent of the vote against incumbent Austin Quinn-Davidson.
He ran for Anchorage Assembly District 1 Seat B in 2023, losing to incumbent Christopher Constant, and for District 1 Seat L in 2025, receiving 8.3 percent against incumbent Daniel Volland.
In the April 7, 2026 election for District 1 Seat B, he received 5.4 percent of the vote and Sydney Scout won.
